'''''Picnomon''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the tribe [[Cardueae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/3611084#page/662/mode/1up Adanson, Michel. 1763.  Familles des Plantes 2: 116, 590 ] in French; spelled "''Picnomon''" on page 116, "''Piknomon''" on page 590</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40008479 Tropicos, ''Picnomon'' Adans.]</ref> The only known species is '''''Picnomon acarna''''', native to [[Europe]], [[Asia]], and [[Africa]] from [[Portugal]] and the [[Canary Islands]] to [[Kazakhstan]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Genere Picnomon - Flora Italiana |url=https://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Picnomon |access-date=2024-07-16 |website=luirig.altervista.org}}</ref>
